title: Easy to put together
text: Easy to put together. Easy to put together.  All the pieces were still in the box.  It wasn't packed very well.  The screws were in bags that were busted open.  The box was busted at the bottom.  I'm surprised the screws didn't fall out.  Screws and other small items would be better served vacuum sealed to a piece of cardboard.  The base is sturdy and is nice in appearance.
